learning_outcomes.text: Evaluate and homogenize levels. Present designer analysis tools - dimensioning and verification calculations in mechanical design - methods for synthesizing solutions.
Introduce the project to be carried out in practical work.
Homogenize knowledge in mechanical manufacturing by providing theoretical and practical knowledge associated with machining methods and programming of Computer Numerical Control (CNC) machine tools.

syllabus_topics: Design and CAD
The user and usage functions, technological solutions
Mechanism: kinematics and motion transformations, power, its flow, efficiency, mechanism safety and critical points
Schematization: minimum kinematic diagram, sketches and design
Representation and its formalisms, notions of tolerances
Digital modeling tools: 3D experience
Nomenclature: reference element for management, designations, definition and use of materials
Industrial manufacturing methods and CAM
Product industrialization approach, integration of design and production means
Methodology for developing a manufacturing project:
Analysis of the definition drawing (dimensioning, material...)
Development of the manufacturing range:
Choice of capable processes and definition of the process
Choice of control means (measurement means capability)
Optimization of the implementation of a numerically controlled machine:
Editing machine programs (generation, simulation, transfer)
Preparation of tooling:
Assembly and dimensional characterization of fixtures and cutting tools
Stabilization of the production process

Practical work: Realization of a project by implementing the digital chain in Design-Manufacturing-Measurement using the "TopSOLID, TopCAM" software: from model to reality, from numerical definition to the "chip"
Study a mechanism and prepare the manufacturing file
In a CAM environment, generate tool paths
Transfer programs and operate numerically controlled machines
Control the process using traditional measuring instruments and three-dimensional metrology
Propose corrective actions (adjustment...)
degree: Diplôme d'ingénieur Centrale Nantes, spécialité Mécanique (apprentissage)
